The retrieved documents don't cover Pedro de la Rosa's career beyond the 2000 European Grand Prix, where he drove for Arrows. The documents therefore can't establish his full set of teammates. The answer below comes from my own recollection, not the documents.

From memory, de la Rosa was a McLaren test and race driver in the mid-2000s, where Kimi Räikkönen was a teammate. Räikkönen won the 2007 Drivers' Championship. I have not verified the exact dates or race starts of that overlap, so treat this as unconfirmed.

Kimi Räikkönen

ANSWER: Kimi Räikkönen
